description: Source code for the 'attacher' component of Kubernetes FlexVolume plugin, implementing volume attachment and mounting logic.

classes.name: flexVolumeAttacher
classes.description: Implements volume.Attacher and volume.DeviceMounter interfaces for FlexVolume plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a volume to a node using plugin driver call.

methods.name: WaitForAttach
methods.description: Waits for volume attachment to complete.

methods.name: GetDeviceMountPath
methods.description: Returns the device mount path for a volume.

methods.name: MountDevice
methods.description: Mounts the device to the specified path.

methods.name: VolumesAreAttached
methods.description: Checks if volumes are attached to a node.
